episode_counts.identity: an episode is (arm, train_seed, episode_seed, num_rounds). num_rounds is PART OF THE IDENTITY: each (arm, train_seed, episode_seed) triple is replayed at horizons 6, 10 and 14, so counting triples undercounts episodes by exactly 3x.
episode_counts.cross_check: 4 arms x 3 seeds x 48 episodes = 576, drawn = 576

answer_parse_agreement.definition: action parsed from the turn's answer text vs the environment's recorded defect_indices for that turn; over parsed decision turns only (unparseable answers are not counted in either numerator or denominator)

coverage_note: grim and tft each have both arms at 3 training seeds. tft/inf exists at ONE seed (train_seed 1) and grim/inf at none, so no inf contrast is computable; inf is excluded from every panel and BLUE, which is reserved for it, appears nowhere on this figure.
error_bar_definition: all bars and bands are BETWEEN TRAINING SEED: per-seed value, then sd/sqrt(3). Arm differences use the paired per-seed delta. Binomial SE is the sampling floor and is not drawn.
minimum_n_rule: an interval is drawn only if every contributing seed has >= 5 blocks in the subgroup; otherwise the mean is drawn without an interval and flagged. Means are still reported here.

panel_a.position_restriction: 0..5 only: every horizon (6, 10, 14) reaches 5 from the end and no further, so each drawn position is an equal mix of the three horizons

grim|m_endgame_defect_plan|delta_eg_minu.definition: mean over positions 0..5 of rate(eg) - rate(nohole) for m_endgame_defect_plan on decision turns, per seed then between-seed

grim|m_endgame_hold|delta_eg_minus_nohol.definition: mean over positions 0..5 of rate(eg) - rate(nohole) for m_endgame_hold on decision turns, per seed then between-seed

tft|m_endgame_defect_plan|delta_eg_minus.definition: mean over positions 0..5 of rate(eg) - rate(nohole) for m_endgame_defect_plan on decision turns, per seed then between-seed

tft|m_endgame_hold|delta_eg_minus_nohole.definition: mean over positions 0..5 of rate(eg) - rate(nohole) for m_endgame_hold on decision turns, per seed then between-seed

denominators.n_empty_answer_rate: trace_markers.json -> cells -> n_empty_answer_rate is over ALL turns in the cell; the denominator is the cell's n_blocks, reported per cell below as n_blocks_all_turns

headline: No DETECTABLE selective suppression: spike difference +0.36 +/- 0.19 vs tft, +0.02 +/- 0.20 vs grim; the level drop is a tft result (-0.31 +/- 0.12), not a grim one; and the stated plan predicts the action no better than nothing does

interval_width_disclaimer.rendered_text: THIS IS NOT AN EQUIVALENCE RESULT, AND THE GRIM HALF OF THIS FIGURE IS NOT ONE. Every arm difference here is between-seed on n=3 and correspondingly wide: the widest drawn is the panel C arm gap under "plan absent" vs tft at -0.346 +/- 0.297. The difference the headline rests on, the grim spike difference, is +0.021 +/- 0.204 -- 0.1 sigma, admitting anything from -0.388 to +0.430 at +/-2 SE, the complete flattening of the grim endgame spike included. A WIDE INTERVAL CONTAINING ZERO IS A FAILURE TO DETECT, NOT A DEMONSTRATION OF ABSENCE. No panel here shows that the penalty leaves endgame reasoning alone.
interval_width_disclaimer.definition: the arm-difference intervals scanned are every delta_eg_minus_nohole this figure prints: the panel A spike differences and level shifts, the panel B behaviour gaps, and the panel C per-subgroup gaps

widest_interval_drawn.what: panel C arm gap under "plan absent" vs tft

widest_interval_including_min_n_flagged.what: panel C arm gap under "plan absent" vs grim

interval_width_disclaimer.note: a wide interval containing zero is a failure to detect, not a demonstration of absence. The one claim on this figure that clears the 2-sigma bar it sets for itself is the tft LEVEL shift; the spike differences and the plan-conditioned gaps do not, and panel C records survives_between_seed_se_at_2_sigma false for both opponents.
